reason: The paid v23 development run completed 26 successful transports but candidate assembly stopped because eight otherwise-canonical reviewer classifications contradicted their own redundant decision or change_reasons metadata. After inspecting those consumed-development outputs, v24 derives decision and ordered closed reasons from the validated primary-versus-review classification, records whether metadata was normalized, preserves exact evidence validation for every derived changed category, and repairs only the response fragment for one packet. This zero-transport replay measures that parser and selector correction against the already-consumed responses. It was designed after seeing those outputs and cannot approve release.

cohort.selection: fixed-seed 40 each en/zh-cn/ja from the consumed 500-row development cohort; unchanged from v18 and v23

source_run.assembly_result: blocked before candidate write because eight review rows failed the v22 redundant-metadata consistency parser

selection.classification_authority: the reviewer's complete validated canonical classification
selection.derived_metadata: decision and ordered change_reasons are derived from the canonical primary-versus-review diff
selection.unchanged: accept with empty change_reasons and evidence; contradictory closed reviewer metadata is discarded and metadata_normalized is true
selection.changed: replace with derived ordered reasons; the evidence array must contain at least as many exact valid rows as there are derived changed categories, but the wire schema does not map individual rows to reasons
selection.repair_scope: one invalid post-brand packet receives only its matching response fragment, never the whole batch response
selection.failure: unknown reason values, invalid canonical classifications, invalid or insufficient changed-case evidence, identity/cardinality errors, or a failed repair leave the post unpublished

decision_rule: Apply the same consumed-development continuation floors frozen for v23. A pass may justify a separately frozen 500-row development run but cannot approve release because this parser was designed after inspecting these responses.
global_stop: Every provider call must resolve from the exact frozen response corpus. The first cache miss stops the replay before transport because request, attempt, token, and dollar caps are all zero.
